text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The second summer training camp had ended without a hitch, and as for Curren Chan..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...I really love the sound of the waves.
choice_data_list: It really puts my mind at ease.
It gives you a peaceful feeling, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Perhaps it feels that way
because the listener is in a calm state of mind.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
During last year's summer training camp,
I didn't feel anything like this.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But this year... feels so refreshing♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...It's definitely because you were watching over me, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...It's definitely because you were watching over me, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Still, I guess it really hit home for me...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
At last, the Sprinters Stakes
is finally next.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"From here on out...
keep your eyes only on Curren, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With a calmer demeanor than usual, Curren Chan seemed somewhat mature...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling her undeniable growth,
the summer training camp came to an end.
